WITH _b AS (SELECT
  strftime(sb."Thời gian", '%Y%m%d') || '-' || sb."Ma don" AS order_id,
  CAST(strftime(sb."Thời gian", '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE) AS order_date,
  CAST(sb."Giờ" AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts,
  NULL AS product_code,
  COALESCE(dm."Hàng", sb."Hàng bán") AS product_name,
  NULL AS product_group,
  CASE
    WHEN dm."Hàng" IS NOT NULL AND sb.dvt = dm."Loại ĐV" THEN sb."SL bán" * dm."Hệ số"
    ELSE sb."SL bán"
  END AS qty,
  CASE
    WHEN dm."Hàng" IS NOT NULL AND sb.dvt = dm."Loại ĐV" THEN dm."ĐV gốc"
    ELSE sb.dvt
  END AS unit,
  sb."Amount" AS amount,
  NULL AS customer_id,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sb."Khách hàng (tên)")) IN ('khách lẻ', 'kl', 'lẻ', 'vãng lai', '') THEN NULL
    ELSE sb."Khách hàng (tên)"
  END AS customer_name,
  NULL AS staff,
  NULL AS channel,
  NULL AS payment,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sb."Trạng thái xử lý")) IN ('huỷ đơn', 'không giao được') THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS is_cancelled,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sb."Trạng thái xử lý")) IN ('hàng trả về', 'đổi trả', 'trả lại', 'đã trả hàng') THEN TRUE
    WHEN sb."SL bán" < 0 THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS is_returned,
  'item' AS line_kind
FROM sobanhang_all sb
LEFT JOIN danhmuc dm ON LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(sb."Hàng bán", ' +', ' ', 'g'))) = LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(dm."Hàng", ' +', ' ', 'g')))),
_p AS (SELECT product_name AS n, lower(trim(unit)) AS u, median(amount / qty) AS pr FROM _b WHERE qty > 0 AND amount > 0 AND product_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2),
_k AS (SELECT n, u, greatest(1, round(pr / min(pr) OVER (PARTITION BY n))) AS k FROM _p)
SELECT _b.* REPLACE (_b.qty * coalesce(_k.k, 1) AS qty) FROM _b LEFT JOIN _k ON _b.product_name = _k.n AND lower(trim(_b.unit)) = _k.u
